title: Geometric stalk of pro-etale extension by zero outside the open
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, j: U -> X an open immersion of schemes, Omega an algebraically closed field, and y: Spec Omega -> X a geometric point which does not factor through j. For every sheaf F of A-modules on the small pro-etale site of U, the pointed-neighbourhood geometric stalk at y of j_! F is a zero A-module.

proof.text: Nonfactorization of the geometric point through the open immersion means its underlying point is outside the image, by IsOpenImmersion.lift and lift_fac. For each pointed neighbourhood N and section s, apply the existing proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_map_eq_zero_openImmersionLowerShriek (Open.LocalVanishing) to obtain a weakly etale refinement f: V -> N containing a point over the chosen point of N and killing s. This theorem proves local vanishing directly from the sheafified Kan-extension definition by local surjectivity of sheafification and an empty comma category. The fibre product V x_N Spec Omega is nonempty by Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback. Its structural map is weakly etale; lem-fix-weakly-etale-algclosed-section supplies a section, producing a compatible geometric lift to V. This is a pointed refinement M -> N, and colimit.w identifies the class of s with the zero restriction. Colimit.hom_ext and ModuleCat.hom_ext show the colimit identity is zero, hence it is a zero object.

lean.statement:
theorem openExtension_outside_stalk (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hy : ¬ ∃ z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U, z ≫ j = y)
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    IsZero (Scheme.proEtaleGeometricFixedModuleStalk y A
      ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).obj F))
